construction site where an occupied nest tree is within 0.5 miles of the Covered Activity, the
Designated Biologist(s) shall observe the occupied nest(s) for at least one hour or until nest
status can be determined. The Designated Biologist(s) shall document nesting status and behaviors to compare to nesting status and behaviors after Covered Activities begin.
Permittee shall report the results of…
requirements.deliverable: Documented baseline SWHA nest status observations reported to CDFW within 24 hours of each survey

asNeeded.trigger: occupied SWHA nest tree within 0.5 miles of a Project construction site

timing.stated: Five days and three days prior to the initiation of Covered Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nest Monitoring During Covered Activities
requirements.name: Monitor SWHA Nest Status at Tiered Distances During Construction
requirements.text:
Where an occupied nest tree occurs between 325 and 650 feet of Covered Activities, the
Designated Biologist(s) shall observe the nest for at least two hours per day during Covered
Activities to ensure the SWHA are engaged in normal nesting behavior.
requirements.deliverable: Documented SWHA nest status and behavior observations during Covered Activities, at a frequency set by distance from the nest

timing.stated:
the Designated Biologist(s) shall observe the nest for at least two hours per day during Covered
Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nest Monitoring During Covered Activities
requirements.name: Limit Work to Daylight Hours Near Occupied SWHA Nest
requirements.text:
Permittee shall limit
Covered Activities to between 30 minutes after sunrise and 30 minutes before sunset.
requirements.deliverable: Daylight-only work schedule (30 minutes after sunrise to 30 minutes before sunset) near an occupied SWHA nest 150-325 feet away

asNeeded.trigger: occupied SWHA nest tree between 150 and 325 feet of Covered Activities

timing.stated: between 30 minutes after sunrise and 30 minutes before sunset

requirements.commitmentTitle: Disturbance of Occupied SWHA Nest Tree
requirements.name: Prohibit Physical Contact With Occupied SWHA Nest Trees
requirements.text:
Permittee shall prohibit physical contact with an occupied nest tree throughout the breeding season
(see Condition of Approval 11.70).
requirements.deliverable: No-contact compliance record for occupied SWHA nest trees

timing.stated: throughout the breeding season

requirements.commitmentTitle: Disturbance of Occupied SWHA Nest Tree
requirements.name: Keep Break Areas and Idle Equipment Out of Nest Sightlines
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not designate any employee break, rest, or
meeting areas in proximity to active SWHA nests. All Project personnel within 656 feet shall be out of
the line of sight of the occupied nest tree during breaks, rests, or meeting areas unless prior approval
has been obtained in writing from CDFW. In consultation with the Designated Biologist(s), Permittee
shall stage stationary, not in-use equipment outside of sight lines from the SWHA nests.
requirements.deliverable: Break/meeting areas and idle equipment kept out of line of sight of occupied SWHA nests, or a CDFW-approved exception

timing.stated:
unless prior approval
has been obtained in writing from CDFW

requirements.commitmentTitle: Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA
requirements.name: Stop Work and Notify Designated Representative of SWHA Distress
requirements.text:
If, during Covered Activities, the Designated Biologist(s) determine(s) that nesting SWHA within 0.5
miles of the Project construction site are exhibiting distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior from
Covered Activities (swooping/stooping, excessive vocalization (e.g., distress calls), agitation, failure to
remain on nest, failure to deliver prey items for an extended time period, failure to maintain nest,
etc.), the Designated Biologist(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities…
requirements.deliverable: Documented stop-work determination and immediate notice to the Designated Representative upon distressed SWHA nesting behavior

asNeeded.trigger: Designated Biologist determines nesting SWHA within 0.5 miles are exhibiting distress or abnormal nesting behavior from Covered Activities

timing.stated: immediately notify Designated Representative

requirements.commitmentTitle: Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA
requirements.name: Notify CDFW of SWHA Nesting Distress Within 24 Hours
requirements.text:
The Designated Representative shall contact CDFW
within 24 hours to determine additional protective measures to be implemented.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notification of nesting SWHA distress, within 24 hours

asNeeded.trigger: Designated Biologist determines nesting SWHA distress or abnormal behavior

timing.stated: within 24 hours

requirements.commitmentTitle: Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA
requirements.name: Continue Monitoring Until CDFW Confirms Normalized SWHA Behavior
requirements.text:
The Designated
Biologist(s) shall: (1) Stop Covered Activities until additional protective measures are implemented; (2) Continue monitoring and ensure additional protective measures remain in place until the
Designated Biologist(s) in coordination with CDFW determines SWHA behavior has normalized; (3) Determine if additional protective measures are ineffective and stop Covered Activities until the
additional protective measures are modified; and (4) Continue monitoring until it has been…
requirements.deliverable: Documented protective-measure implementation and continued monitoring until CDFW confirms normalized SWHA behavior

timing.stated:
until it has been determined by CDFW that the SWHA behavior has
normalized

requirements.commitmentTitle: Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA
requirements.name: Notify CDFW of SWHA Nest or Nestling Abandonment Within 24 Hours
requirements.text:
The Designated Representative or Designated Biologist shall notify CDFW within 24
hours if nests or nestlings are abandoned and notify CDFW whether abandoned nestlings are
still alive.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notification of SWHA nest or nestling abandonment and nestling survival status, within 24 hours

asNeeded.trigger: SWHA nests or nestlings are abandoned

timing.stated:
within 24
hours

requirements.commitmentTitle: Designated Biologist Authority for Distressed Nesting SWHA
requirements.name: Extend Nest Monitoring to Newly Discovered SWHA Nests
requirements.text:
If no occupied
SWHA nests initially occur at or within 0.5 mile of the Project construction site, any discovery of nests
shall trigger the monitoring and records required under this Condition of Approval as well as
Conditions of Approval 11.72, 11.73, and 11.74.
requirements.deliverable: Distance-tiered monitoring and records extended to any newly discovered SWHA nest

asNeeded.trigger: discovery of a SWHA nest not initially present at or within 0.5 mile of the Project construction site

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval
requirements.name: Avoid Removal of Known and Suitable SWHA Nest Trees
requirements.text:
Permittee shall avoid removal of known SWHA nest trees and suitable
nest trees to the maximum extent practicable.
requirements.deliverable: Documented avoidance of known and suitable SWHA nest tree removal

timing.stated: to the maximum extent practicable

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval
requirements.name: Obtain CDFW Approval Before Removing a Known SWHA Nest Tree
requirements.text:
If a known nest tree must be removed for Covered
Activities, Permittee shall notify and obtain written approval from CDFW. The notification shall
include the location of the known nest tree, conditions to offset the loss of the nest tree, and the
timing of removal, which shall generally be September 16 – February 28.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW written approval to remove a known SWHA nest tree, with location, offset conditions and removal timing

asNeeded.trigger: a known SWHA nest tree must be removed for Covered Activities

timing.stated: generally be September 16 – February 28

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nest Tree Avoidance and Removal Approval
requirements.name: Prohibit Removal of Occupied SWHA Nest Trees Until Fledging
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not remove
any occupied nest tree during nesting season, until the last young have left the nest, as verified by
the Designated Biologist(s).
requirements.deliverable: Designated Biologist verification that no occupied SWHA nest tree is removed until the last young have fledged

asNeeded.trigger: an occupied SWHA nest tree is present during the nesting season

timing.stated:
until the last young have left the nest, as verified by
the Designated Biologist(s)

requirements.commitmentTitle: Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season
requirements.name: Time Woody Vegetation Removal to September 16–February 28
requirements.text:
Permittee shall conduct removal of woody vegetation (trees and shrubs) only between September 16 - February 28 of any construction year to avoid impacts to nesting birds, unless preconstruction
surveys are conducted by the Designated Biologist(s) and recently used SWHA nests or active SWHA
nests are determined to be absent from the trees and/or shrubs to be removed.
requirements.deliverable: Woody vegetation removal timed to the September 16–February 28 window, or cleared by a preconstruction nest-absence survey

timing.stated: between September 16 - February 28 of any construction year

requirements.commitmentTitle: Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season
requirements.name: Notify CDFW of Nest Survey Results Before Vegetation Removal
requirements.text:
The Designated
Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW of survey results prior to any vegetation removal.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notification of preconstruction nest survey results before any woody vegetation removal

asNeeded.trigger: vegetation removal is about to occur

timing.stated: prior to any vegetation removal

requirements.commitmentTitle: Woody Vegetation Removal Outside SWHA Nesting Season
requirements.name: Delineate and Avoid 656-Foot Buffer Around Active SWHA Nests
requirements.text:
If active or recently
used SWHA nests are present, the Permittee shall not remove vegetation within 656 feet of SWHA
nests. The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate, flag, and avoid any
active nests until the nesting cycle is complete (refer to Condition of Approval 11.72).
requirements.responsibleParty: Permittee, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: 656-foot no-removal buffer delineated and maintained around active or recently used SWHA nests until the nesting cycle is complete

asNeeded.trigger: active or recently used SWHA nests are present in vegetation to be removed

timing.stated: until the nesting cycle is complete

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities
requirements.name: Delineate and Avoid SWHA Nesting Habitat at Preconstruction Sites
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting habitat with
flagging or other highly visible markers within each Project preconstruction site(s). Permittee shall
restrict preconstruction activities to areas outside of the delineated nesting habitat.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s), and Permittee
requirements.deliverable: Suitable SWHA nesting habitat delineated with flagging and excluded from preconstruction activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities
requirements.name: Schedule Preconstruction Field Investigations Outside Nesting Season
requirements.text:
Permittee shall conduct preconstruction activities such as field investigations outside of the nesting season to the
maximum extent practicable.
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction field investigations scheduled outside the SWHA nesting season

asNeeded.trigger: preconstruction field investigations are being scheduled

timing.stated:
outside of the nesting season to the
maximum extent practicable

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities
requirements.name: Survey for Nesting SWHA Before In-Season Field Investigations
requirements.text:
If such activities must occur during the nesting season, the Designated
Biologist(s) shall survey the preconstruction activity site and within 0.5 miles for nesting SWHA.
requirements.deliverable: SWHA nesting survey of the preconstruction activity site and surrounding 0.5 mile, when work occurs during the nesting season

asNeeded.trigger: preconstruction field investigations must occur during the SWHA nesting season

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Nesting Habitat Delineation for Preconstruction Activities
requirements.name: Keep Field Investigations 0.5 Miles From Occupied SWHA Nests
requirements.text:
Permittee shall limit field investigation activities to at least 0.5 miles away from any occupied nest
tree, unless otherwise approved by CDFW in writing.
requirements.deliverable: Field investigation activities kept at least 0.5 miles from any occupied SWHA nest tree, or a CDFW-approved exception

asNeeded.trigger: an occupied SWHA nest tree is within 0.5 miles of planned field investigation activities

timing.stated: unless otherwise approved by CDFW in writing

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.name: Prohibit Helicopter Line Stringing Near Occupied SWHA Nests
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not use helicopters to string SCADA or transmission lines within 0.5 miles of an
occupied nest tree.
requirements.deliverable: SCADA/transmission line stringing conducted without helicopters within 0.5 mile of an occupied SWHA nest tree

asNeeded.trigger: an occupied SWHA nest tree is within 0.5 miles of planned SCADA or transmission line stringing

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.name: Prohibit Occupied Nest Tree Removal for Transmission Line Work
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not remove or trim occupied nest trees for transmission line
construction until after the breeding season has ended and the last of the young have left the nest.
Permittee shall not remove or trim occupied nest trees during transmission line maintenance.
requirements.deliverable: No removal or trimming of occupied SWHA nest trees for transmission line construction or maintenance until fledging

asNeeded.trigger: an occupied SWHA nest tree is present at a transmission line construction or maintenance site

timing.stated: until after the breeding season has ended and the last of the young have left the nest

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.name: Remove or Trim an Occupied Nest Tree for Safety Per 11.77 or CDFW Approval
requirements.text:
If
removal or trimming of an occupied nest tree needs to occur for human or wildlife safety, Permittee
shall conduct removal or trimming consistent with Conditions of Approval 11.77, or otherwise with
written approval and guidance from CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: Occupied SWHA nest tree removed or trimmed for safety consistent with Condition 11.77, or with CDFW written approval and guidance

asNeeded.trigger: removal or trimming of an occupied nest tree is needed for human or wildlife safety

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.name: Avoid Nest Tree Removal During SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.text:
Permittee shall avoid removal or trimming of known or
suitable nest trees, to the extent practicable, during SCADA and transmission line stringing and
reconductoring activities and during power and pole placement.
requirements.deliverable: Documented avoidance of known/suitable SWHA nest tree removal during SCADA/transmission line stringing, reconductoring and pole placement

timing.stated: to the extent practicable

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Measures for SCADA and Transmission Line Work
requirements.name: Site Poles and Lines Outside Suitable SWHA Nesting Habitat
requirements.text:
Where practicable, Permittee shall
place poles and lines outside of suitable nesting habitat, as delineated by the Designated Biologist(s).
requirements.deliverable: Poles and lines sited outside suitable SWHA nesting habitat delineated by the Designated Biologist

timing.stated: Where practicable

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan
requirements.name: Develop and Submit SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan
requirements.text:
Permittee shall develop a SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (SWHA Relocation Plan)
and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package
(Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.
requirements.deliverable: SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan submitted to CDFW in the Construction Phase Authorization Package

timing.stated: prior to initiating Covered Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: SWHA Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan
requirements.name: Restrict SWHA Capture and Handling to Qualified Designated Biologist
requirements.text:
SWHA
shall only be captured and handled by the CDFW-approved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate
expertise in handling raptors.
requirements.deliverable: SWHA capture and handling performed only by a CDFW-approved Designated Biologist with raptor expertise

asNeeded.trigger: SWHA capture or handling is needed

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of SWHA Take or Injury
requirements.name: Notify Designated Biologist of SWHA Take, Injury or Death
requirements.text:
Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if a SWHA is taken or injured by a
Covered Activity, or if a SWHA is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project
preconstruction activity site, construction site, or maintenance area.
requirements.deliverable: Immediate internal notice to the Designated Biologist of a taken, injured, or dead SWHA

asNeeded.trigger: a SWHA is taken or injured by a Covered Activity, or found dead or injured near the Project

timing.stated: immediately

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of SWHA Take or Injury
requirements.name: Transport Injured SWHA to Rehabilitation Facility at Permittee's Cost
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall
immediately take the SWHA to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility
identified in the SWHA Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.80) and contact the CDFW
Representative, via email and telephone, within one business day to discuss the next steps. Permittee
shall bear any costs associated with the care or treatment of such injured SWHA.
requirements.deliverable: Injured SWHA transported to the CDFW-approved rehabilitation/veterinary facility named in the SWHA Relocation Plan, at Permittee's cost

asNeeded.trigger: a SWHA is found injured

timing.stated: within one business day

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of SWHA Take or Injury
requirements.name: Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of SWHA Nest Abandonment or Distress
requirements.text:
The Designated
Biologist(s) shall immediately notify CDFW (within 24 hours) if nesting SWHA abandon the nest or
exhibit distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notification within 24 hours of SWHA nest abandonment or distress/abnormal nesting behavior

asNeeded.trigger: nesting SWHA abandon the nest or exhibit distress or abnormal nesting behavior

timing.stated: within 24 hours

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of SWHA Take or Injury
requirements.name: Provide Initial CDFW Notification With Event Details
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) or Designated
Representative shall provide initial notification to CDFW by contacting the CDFW Representative. The
initial notification to CDFW shall include information regarding the location, species, date, and
circumstances of the event (e.g., time where the individual was found, number of animals taken or
injured, description of abnormal nesting behavior, etc.), the name of the facility where the animal
was taken if applicable, and the ITP Number.
requirements.deliverable: Initial CDFW notification of the take/injury/abandonment/distress event, with location, species, date, circumstances, facility and ITP number

asNeeded.trigger: a SWHA take, injury, death, nest abandonment or distress event occurs

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of SWHA Take or Injury
requirements.name: Submit Written Incident Report to CDFW Within Two Business Days
requirements.text:
Following initial notification, Permittee shall send CDFW
a written incident report within two business days to the CDFW offices listed in the Notices section of
this ITP. The incident report shall include the date and time of the finding or incident, disposition of
the SWHA, location of the animal or carcass or the name of the facility where the animal was taken,
any photographs of the animal or the site it was found, explanation as to cause of take, injury, or
nesting disturbance, and any…
requirements.deliverable: Written SWHA incident report sent to CDFW within two business days and included in the Monthly Compliance Report

asNeeded.trigger: following initial CDFW notification of a take, injury or nesting disturbance event

timing.stated: within two business days

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window
requirements.name: Restrict Work Hours Near Occupied TRBL Colony or Roost
requirements.text:
Permittee shall restrict Covered Activities to 45 minutes after sunrise and 45 minutes before sunset
when Covered Activities occur within 1,300 feet of a breeding colony or roost site occupied by TRBL,
unless otherwise approved by CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: Covered Activities within 1,300 feet of an occupied TRBL breeding colony or roost restricted to between 45 minutes after sunrise and 45 minutes before sunset, or a CDFW-approved exception

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities occur within 1,300 feet of a breeding colony or roost site occupied by TRBL

timing.stated: unless otherwise approved by CDFW

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window
requirements.name: Train Project Personnel on TRBL Avoidance and Buffer Protocols
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall train Project personnel on the required avoidance procedures, buffer zones, and protocols in the event that a TRBL flies into an
active Project construction site (i.e., outside the buffer zone), as part of the education program
described in Condition of Approval 9.4.
requirements.deliverable: Project personnel trained on TRBL avoidance procedures, buffer zones, and the in-site-flyover protocol, as part of the Condition of Approval 9.4 education program

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Avoidance and Daily Activity Window
requirements.name: Coordinate Timing of Disruptive Activities Away From Vulnerable TRBL Periods
requirements.text:
To the maximum extent feasible, Permittee shall coordinate
with the Designated Biologist(s) and CDFW to time the loudest or otherwise most disruptive Covered
Activities outside periods where the TRBL, their nests/colony, their eggs, or their young are most
vulnerable to disturbance.
requirements.responsibleParty: Permittee, in coordination with the Designated Biologist(s) and CDFW
requirements.deliverable: Loudest or most disruptive Covered Activities scheduled outside the periods when TRBL, their nests/colony, eggs, or young are most vulnerable to disturbance

timing.stated: To the maximum extent feasible

requirements.name: Conduct Baseline TRBL Habitat Assessment Each Project Phase
requirements.text:
Prior to the commencement of Covered Activities for each Project Phase, the Designated Biologist(s)
shall conduct a habitat assessment consistent with CDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to determine if existing or potential nesting or foraging sites are present within the Project site
and include areas within three miles of Project sites, where feasible. The preconstruction (i.e.,
baseline) assessment shall be completed during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15)…
requirements.deliverable: Baseline TRBL habitat assessment completed during the breeding season within the Project site and, where feasible, the surrounding three miles, before each Project Phase begins

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities are about to commence for a new Project Phase

timing.stated: Prior to the commencement of Covered Activities for each Project Phase

requirements.name: Map and Submit Nesting/Foraging Sites in Phase Authorization Package
requirements.text:
Permittee shall map all existing or potential
nesting or foraging sites and provide these maps to CDFW as part of the appropriate Phase
Authorization Package (see Condition of Approval 10.3). Nesting sites, including both currently
occupied nesting sites and sites known to have been occupied within the last five years, shall be
noted on plans that are submitted as a part of a Phase Authorization Package (see Condition of
Approval 6.1 and 6.2).
requirements.deliverable: Maps of all existing/potential TRBL nesting and foraging sites, with currently and recently (five-year) occupied sites noted on plans, submitted to CDFW in the Phase Authorization Package

asNeeded.trigger: a Phase Authorization Package is being assembled

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys
requirements.name: Survey TRBL Habitat and Acquire Colony Data Before Any Covered Activities
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct
CDFW approved TRBL survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to identify the presence of
suitable nesting habitat and roosting habitat, within each preconstruction activity site, SCADA,
transmission line and access road site, construction site, and maintenance area, prior to initiation of
any Covered Activities. Permittee shall contact the UC Davis Tricolored Blackbird Portal Project…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction TRBL survey of each preconstruction, SCADA, transmission line/access road, construction, and maintenance site, informed by current UC Davis Tricolored Blackbird Portal colony data

timing.stated:
prior to initiation of
any Covered Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys
requirements.name: Submit Preconstruction TRBL Survey Results to CDFW
requirements.text:
Permittee shall submit results of the preconstruction surveys to
CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction TRBL survey results submitted to CDFW in the Construction Phase Authorization Package before initiating Covered Activities

timing.stated: prior to initiating Covered Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys
requirements.name: Conduct and Report Annual TRBL Surveys During Construction and Maintenance
requirements.text:
Subsequent survey efforts conducted during the Project
construction phase(s) or maintenance shall occur each year Covered Activities are expected to occur
in TRBL habitat and shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within the Monthly Compliance
Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each Annual Status Report
(Condition of Approval 10.13).
requirements.deliverable: Annual TRBL survey during each year Covered Activities occur in TRBL habitat, reported in the Monthly Compliance Report and summarized in the Annual Status Report

timing.stated:
each year Covered Activities are expected to occur
in TRBL habitat

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat Surveys
requirements.name: Map and Provide TRBL Nesting/Roosting Sites to CDFW
requirements.text:
Permittee shall map all existing or potential nesting or roosting sites
and provide these maps to CDFW (see Condition of Approval 10.3).
requirements.deliverable: Map of all existing or potential TRBL nesting and roosting sites provided to CDFW

asNeeded.trigger: existing or potential TRBL nesting or roosting sites are identified by survey

requirements.name: Conduct Seasonal Preconstruction Surveys for TRBL Breeding Colonies and Nesting Habitat
requirements.text:
Prior to the initiation of Covered Activities in a Project site and within
1,300 feet of the Project site unless otherwise approved by CDFW, the Designated Biologist(s)
with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct preconstruction surveys
to evaluate the presence of TRBL breeding colonies and suitable nesting habitat. Surveys shall be
conducted during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15) one year prior to, and then
again in the year of, the Covered Activities…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Documented monthly (March–July, September) TRBL breeding-colony and nesting-habitat surveys one year before and in the year of Covered Activities, plus the mid-season three-survey sequence and reinitiation surveys when work starts or resumes during the breeding season

timing.stated:
each year
Covered Activities are expected to occur in or within 1,300 feet of TRBL habitat

requirements.name: Delineate Suitable Nesting Habitat and Breeding Colonies With Flagging
requirements.text:
The
Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting habitat and
breeding colonies with flagging or other visible marking.
requirements.deliverable: Suitable TRBL nesting habitat and breeding colonies delineated with flagging or other visible marking

asNeeded.trigger: the preconstruction survey identifies suitable nesting habitat or a breeding colony

requirements.name: Conduct Preconstruction Roosting Habitat Surveys During the Nonbreeding Season
requirements.text:
Prior to initiation of Covered Activities, including nighttime construction
and postconstruction maintenance activities, in a Project construction site or Project
maintenance area and within 300 feet of a Project site, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance
(if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct preconstruction surveys to establish the
existence and use of roosting habitat by TRBL. Surveys shall be conducted during the nonbreeding
season (September 16 – February 28) one…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction TRBL roosting-habitat survey completed during the nonbreeding season one year before and in the year of Covered Activities in or within 300 feet of a construction or maintenance site, including the accelerated three-survey sequence and reinitiation surveys when work starts or resumes in the nonbreeding season

timing.stated:
Surveys shall be conducted during the nonbreeding
season (September 16 – February 28) one year prior to, and then again in the year of, the
Covered Activities

requirements.name: Presume TRBL Occupancy for Unclearly Identified Mixed Blackbird Flocks
requirements.text:
Permittee shall consider roosting habitat occupied by
large mixed blackbird flocks to be occupied by TRBL if the Designated Biologist(s) cannot clearly
identify TRBL absence within the flock.
requirements.deliverable: Roosting habitat occupied by a large mixed blackbird flock treated as TRBL-occupied unless the Designated Biologist clearly confirms TRBL absence

asNeeded.trigger: a large mixed blackbird flock is found occupying roosting habitat during a survey or occupancy check

requirements.name: Check Previously Unoccupied Roost Sites for Later TRBL Occupancy
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed)
from the Biological Monitor(s) shall check suitable roost sites within 300 feet of Project sites that
are not occupied at the time of preconstruction surveys in accordance with the roosting survey
protocol approved by CDFW (Condition of Approval 11.38), to determine whether TRBL later
occupies the roost site.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Suitable roost sites within 300 feet of Project sites that were unoccupied at the preconstruction survey rechecked under the CDFW-approved protocol to determine later TRBL occupancy

requirements.name: Delineate Occupied TRBL Roost Sites With Flagging
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor shall delineate
occupied roost sites with flagging or visible markings consistent with Condition of Approval 11.90.
requirements.deliverable: Occupied TRBL roost sites delineated with flagging or visible markings consistent with Condition of Approval 11.90

asNeeded.trigger: a roost site is determined to be occupied by TRBL

requirements.name: Avoid Suitable TRBL Nesting Habitat Within 1,300 Feet of Construction Sites
requirements.text:
Permittee shall ensure Covered Activities avoid suitable nesting habitat within 1,300 feet of Project
construction sites to the extent practicable.
requirements.deliverable: Covered Activities kept out of suitable TRBL nesting habitat within 1,300 feet of Project construction sites to the extent practicable

timing.stated: to the extent practicable

requirements.name: Maintain a 1,300-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around an Unavoidable Active TRBL Colony
requirements.text:
If active nests are found within the Project construction
sites or within 1,300 feet of any Covered Activity and cannot be avoided, Permittee shall ensure that
Covered Activities do not occur within a 1,300-foot diameter no-activity buffer zone surrounding the
colony and associated suitable habitat during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15), until
the young have fledged, or when approved by CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: 1,300-foot-diameter no-activity buffer maintained around an unavoidable active TRBL colony during the breeding season until the young fledge, or as CDFW otherwise approves

asNeeded.trigger: active nests are found within the Project construction sites or within 1,300 feet of any Covered Activity and cannot be avoided

requirements.name: Delineate the TRBL Colony No-Activity Buffer
requirements.text:
Permittee shall clearly delineate the buffered
area using fencing or other high visibility marking. Permittee shall delineate TRBL colonies with
different materials than those used to delineate the Project construction site and maintain the
fencing or markings through all weather events.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL colony buffer delineated with fencing or other high-visibility marking, using different materials than the construction-site delineation, maintained through all weather events

asNeeded.trigger: a 1,300-foot no-activity buffer is established around an active TRBL colony

requirements.name: Reduce the TRBL Colony Buffer to 300 Feet With CDFW Approval Where Site Conditions Qualify
requirements.text:
The no-activity buffer zone may be reduced to a
minimum of 300 feet, with written approval from CDFW, in areas with dense forest, buildings, or
other features between the Covered Activities and the breeding colony; where there is topographic
relief to protect the colony from excessive noise or visual disturbance; or where sound curtains have
been installed.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL colony no-activity buffer reduced to as little as 300 feet, with CDFW's written approval, where dense forest, buildings, topographic relief, or installed sound curtains shield the colony

asNeeded.trigger: site conditions (dense forest, buildings, topographic relief, or installed sound curtains) qualify the colony buffer for reduction

timing.stated: with written approval from CDFW

requirements.name: Reduce Disturbance When TRBL Colonizes Habitat Adjacent to Ongoing Activities
requirements.text:
If TRBL colonizes habitat adjacent to Covered Activities after they have been initiated,
Permittee shall reduce the disturbance through establishment of no-activity buffers or sound curtains
as determined in consultation with CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: No-activity buffers or sound curtains established, as determined with CDFW, to reduce disturbance when TRBL colonizes habitat adjacent to activities already underway

asNeeded.trigger: TRBL colonizes habitat adjacent to Covered Activities after they have been initiated

requirements.name: Submit TRBL Buffer Zone Design and Location to CDFW for Approval
requirements.text:
The buffer zone design and location shall be submitted to
CDFW for approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL colony buffer zone design and location submitted to CDFW for approval in the Construction Phase Authorization Package

asNeeded.trigger: a Construction Phase Authorization Package is being assembled

requirements.name: Monitor an Active TRBL Colony Daily Through the Nesting Season
requirements.text:
If nesting TRBL is present within the Project construction site or within 1,300 feet of any Project-
related Covered Activity, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological
Monitor(s) shall monitor the colony daily for at least six hours per day throughout the nesting season
to verify the Covered Activities are not disrupting the colony and to determine when the young have
fledged, unless otherwise approved by CDFW. The Designated Biologist(s) will be on site daily…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Daily on-site monitoring log of the active TRBL colony (at least six hours per day) throughout the nesting season, verifying Covered Activities are not disrupting the colony and tracking fledging

timing.stated: monitor the colony daily for at least six hours per day throughout the nesting season

requirements.name: Prohibit Covered Activities Within the Nest Disturbance Buffer
requirements.text:
Work within
the nest disturbance buffer shall not be permitted.
requirements.deliverable: No Covered Activities conducted within the nest disturbance buffer

requirements.name: Stop Work When the Biologist Observes Colony Disruption and Agitated Behavior
requirements.text:
If the Designated Biologist determines that
Covered Activities are disrupting the colony and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behavior, the
Designated Biologist(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until additional protective
measures are implemented and the buffer size is increased to a distance necessary to result in no
adverse impacts to the TRBL.
requirements.deliverable: Covered Activities stopped by the Designated Biologist when disrupting the colony and TRBL show agitated behavior, until protective measures are added and the buffer enlarged enough to eliminate adverse impact

asNeeded.trigger: the Designated Biologist determines Covered Activities are disrupting the colony and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behavior

requirements.name: Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of a Colony-Disruption Stop-Work Event
requirements.text:
The Permittee’s Designated Representative and/or Designated
Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar day) to determine additional protective
measures to be implemented.
requirements.responsibleParty: Permittee's Designated Representative and/or Designated Biologist(s)
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notified within 24 hours of a colony-disruption stop-work event, to jointly determine additional protective measures

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities are stopped for disrupting the colony

timing.stated: within 24 hours (one calendar day)

requirements.name: Maintain and Adjust Protective Measures Until TRBL Behavior Normalizes
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall continue
monitoring and ensure additional protective measures remain in place for the duration of the
Covered Activities or until it is determined that TRBL behavior has normalized, as approved by CDFW.
Additional protective measures may include, but are not limited to, increasing the size of the buffer,
delaying Covered Activities until the colony is finished breeding and the young have fledged,
temporarily relocating staging…
requirements.deliverable: Additional protective measures (enlarged buffer, delay, relocated staging, rerouted access, or others) kept in place and re-escalated, including renewed work stoppage, until CDFW approves that TRBL behavior has normalized

requirements.name: Consult CDFW on At-Risk Colonies and Report Nest or Nestling Abandonment
requirements.text:
If the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) determines that the colonies are at risk, CDFW shall be immediately consulted to
determine the best course of action to avoid nest abandonment or take of individuals. The
Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar
day) if nests or nestlings are abandoned. If the nestlings are still alive, the Designated Biologist(s)
and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall work with CDFW to determine…
requirements.deliverable: Immediate CDFW consultation for at-risk colonies; phone/email notice to CDFW within 24 hours of nest or nestling abandonment, coordination on next steps for surviving nestlings, and a written incident report within two days included in the Monthly Compliance Report and Annual Status Report

asNeeded.trigger: the colony is determined to be at risk, or nests/nestlings are found abandoned

timing.stated:
within 24 hours (one calendar
day)

requirements.name: Avoid Suitable TRBL Roosting Habitat and Its 300-Foot Buffer
requirements.text:
Permittee shall ensure Covered Activities avoid suitable roosting habitat and a surrounding buffer
area of 300 feet to the extent practicable.
requirements.deliverable: Covered Activities kept out of suitable TRBL roosting habitat and its surrounding 300-foot buffer to the extent practicable

timing.stated: to the extent practicable

requirements.name: Maintain a 300-Foot No-Activity Buffer Around an Unavoidable Occupied TRBL Roost
requirements.text:
If occupied roosting habitat is found within the Project
construction site, and the occupied roosting habitat cannot be avoided, Permittee shall not conduct
Covered Activities within a 300-foot no-activity buffer surrounding the roost site (no-activity buffer).
requirements.deliverable: 300-foot no-activity buffer maintained around an unavoidable occupied TRBL roost site within the Project construction site

asNeeded.trigger: occupied roosting habitat is found within the Project construction site and cannot be avoided

requirements.name: Delineate the TRBL Roost No-Activity Buffer
requirements.text:
Permittee shall clearly delineate the buffered area using fencing or other high visibility marking.
Permittee shall delineate TRBL roosting sites with different materials than those used to delineate
the Project construction site and maintain the fencing or markings throughout all weather events.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL roost buffer delineated with fencing or other high-visibility marking, using different materials than the construction-site delineation, maintained through all weather events

asNeeded.trigger: a 300-foot no-activity buffer is established around an occupied TRBL roost site

requirements.name: Modify the TRBL Roost Buffer Where Site Conditions Qualify, as CDFW Approves
requirements.text:
The no-activity buffer may be modified in areas with dense forest buildings, or other features
between the Covered Activities and the occupied roost site; where there is sufficient topographic
relief to protect the roost site from excessive noise and visual disturbance; or where sound curtains
are installed, as approved by CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL roost no-activity buffer modified, as approved by CDFW, where dense forest, buildings, topographic relief, or installed sound curtains shield the roost site

asNeeded.trigger: site conditions (dense forest, buildings, topographic relief, or installed sound curtains) qualify the roost buffer for modification

timing.stated: as approved by CDFW

requirements.name: Submit TRBL Roost Buffer Zone Design and Location to CDFW for Approval
requirements.text:
The buffer zone design and location shall be submitted to CDFW
for approval as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization Package.
requirements.deliverable: TRBL roost buffer zone design and location submitted to CDFW for approval in the Construction Phase Authorization Package

asNeeded.trigger: a Construction Phase Authorization Package is being assembled

requirements.name: Monitor Occupied Roost Sites Within the 300-Foot Buffer Daily
requirements.text:
Occupied roost sites that are within the 300 feet no-activity buffer (Condition of Approval 11.87)
shall be monitored daily by the Designated Biologist(s), with assistance (if needed) from the Biological
Monitor(s), for at least four hours each day or until the roost site is no longer occupied and consistent
with CDFW-approved TRBL survey protocol (Condition of Approval 11.38) to verify that Covered
Activities are not disrupting roosting TRBL.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s), with assistance from Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Daily monitoring log of occupied roost sites within the 300-foot no-activity buffer (at least four hours per day, or until the roost is no longer occupied), verifying Covered Activities are not disrupting roosting TRBL

timing.stated: for at least four hours each day or until the roost site is no longer occupied

requirements.name: Prohibit Covered Activities Within the Roosting Site
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not conduct Covered Activities within the
roosting site.
requirements.deliverable: No Covered Activities conducted within the occupied roosting site

requirements.name: Implement Additional Protective Measures When Roosting TRBL Show Agitated Behavior
requirements.text:
If the Designated Biologist(s) determines that Covered Activities are disrupting roosting
activity and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behaviors, Permittee shall put additional protective
measures in place until TRBL behavior normalizes. Additional protective measures may include, but
are not limited to, increasing the size of the roosting site no-activity buffer, delaying Covered
Activities until the flock has left the roost site or until the end of the nonbreeding season, temporarily
relocating…
requirements.deliverable: Additional protective measures (enlarged buffer, delay, relocated staging, rerouted access, or sound curtains) put in place until TRBL roosting behavior normalizes

asNeeded.trigger: the Designated Biologist determines Covered Activities are disrupting roosting activity and TRBL are exhibiting agitated behaviors

requirements.name: Contact CDFW When Roost Protective Measures Are Not Reducing Disruption
requirements.text:
Permittee and/or the Designated Biologist(s) shall contact CDFW if protective measures are
not effectively reducing disruption to the roost site to discuss alternative measures.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW contacted to discuss alternative measures whenever the additional protective measures are not effectively reducing roost disturbance

asNeeded.trigger: protective measures are not effectively reducing disruption to the roost site

requirements.commitmentTitle: Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites
requirements.name: Prohibit Physical Contact With Active Breeding Colonies and Occupied Roost Sites
requirements.text:
Permittee shall prohibit physical contact with a breeding colony during the breeding season (March 1 – September 15) from the time of nest site selection until after the chicks have fledged or colony is
no longer active, as determined by a Designated Biologist(s) and approved by CDFW. Permittee shall
prohibit physical contact with an occupied roost site during the nonbreeding season (September 16 –
February 28).
requirements.deliverable: No physical contact with an active breeding colony (nest site selection through fledging or CDFW-approved inactivity) during the breeding season, and none with an occupied roost site during the nonbreeding season

requirements.commitmentTitle: Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites
requirements.name: Prohibit Personnel From Exiting Vehicles Inside an Occupied No-Activity Buffer
requirements.text:
Project personnel shall not exit vehicles when inside the established no-activity buffer
for breeding or roosting when TRBL are present (see Conditions of Approval 11.85 and 11.87).
requirements.deliverable: Project personnel remain in their vehicles whenever inside an established breeding or roosting no-activity buffer occupied by TRBL

requirements.commitmentTitle: Disturbance of TRBL Breeding Colonies and Roost Sites
requirements.name: Prohibit Employee Break, Rest, or Meeting Areas Within or Adjacent to No-Activity Buffers
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not designate any employee break, rest, or meeting areas adjacent to or within the
no-activity nest and roosting buffers.
requirements.deliverable: No employee break, rest, or meeting areas designated adjacent to or within a TRBL nest or roosting no-activity buffer

requirements.commitmentTitle: Delineation of TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat
requirements.name: Delineate TRBL Nesting/Roosting Habitat and Buffers
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall delineate suitable nesting and roosting
habitat and buffers with flagging or other highly visible marking at Project sites for preconstruction
activities, construction staging areas, SCADA, transmission line, and access road construction and
maintenance sites.
requirements.deliverable: Flagged/marked boundaries of suitable nesting/roosting habitat and buffers

requirements.commitmentTitle: Delineation of TRBL Nesting and Roosting Habitat
requirements.name: Restrict Activities Outside Delineated Habitat/Buffers
requirements.text:
Permittee shall restrict these Covered Activities to Project Sites outside of the
delineated habitat. Permittee shall prohibit conduct of Covered Activities within no-activity buffers
established for breeding colonies or occupied roost sites (see Conditions of Approval 11.85 and
11.87).

requirements.commitmentTitle: Helicopter Restrictions Near TRBL Colonies and Roosts
requirements.name: Maintain Helicopter Distance/Time Buffers Near TRBL Sites
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not use helicopters to string SCADA or transmission lines within 200 horizontal feet or
150 vertical feet of breeding colonies or occupied roost sites unless the helicopter is small enough to
only cause a down draft of 15 to 18 miles per hour at up to 150 feet. Permittee shall only operate
helicopters at these distances from the breeding colony or occupied roost site for up to three
minutes in duration, no more than twice per day, with a minimum of four hours between…

asNeeded.trigger: Helicopters string SCADA or transmission lines within 200 horizontal feet or 150 vertical feet of a breeding colony or occupied roost site

requirements.commitmentTitle: Helicopter Restrictions Near TRBL Colonies and Roosts
requirements.name: Restrict Helicopter Use to Daylight Hours
requirements.text:
Helicopters shall not be used
between 45 minutes before sunset to 45 minutes after sunrise.

timing.stated: 45 minutes before sunset to 45 minutes after sunrise

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan
requirements.name: Prepare and Submit TRBL Mortality/Relocation Plan
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall prepare a TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan (TRBL
Relocation Plan) and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase Authorization
Package prior to commencing Covered Activities (Condition of Approval 6.2).
requirements.deliverable: TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan

timing.stated: prior to commencing Covered Activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: TRBL Mortality Reduction and Relocation Plan
requirements.name: Restrict TRBL Handling to CDFW-Approved Biologist
requirements.text:
Only the CDFW-approved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate expertise in
handling blackbirds shall handle and relocate TRBL.

asNeeded.trigger: TRBL individuals require handling or relocation

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Notify Designated Biologist of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.text:
Permittee shall immediately notify the Designated Biologist(s) if TRBL is taken by a Covered Activity,
or if a TRBL is otherwise found dead or injured within the vicinity of the Project preconstruction
activity, construction site, or maintenance area.
requirements.deliverable: Notice to Designated Biologist(s) of TRBL take, death, or injury

asNeeded.trigger: TRBL is taken by a Covered Activity or found dead or injured near the Project

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Transport Injured TRBL to Approved Care Facility
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall immediately take
the injured TRBL to a CDFW-approved wildlife rehabilitation or veterinary facility identified in the
TRBL Relocation Plan (see Condition of Approval 11.92)
requirements.deliverable: Injured TRBL delivered to CDFW-approved rehabilitation/veterinary facility

asNeeded.trigger: an injured TRBL is found

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Notify CDFW Representative Within One Business Day
requirements.text:
contact the CDFW Representative, via
email and telephone, within one business day to discuss the next steps.
requirements.deliverable: Initial notice to CDFW Representative of injured TRBL

asNeeded.trigger: an injured TRBL is found

timing.stated: within one business day

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Bear Costs of Injured TRBL Care and Treatment
requirements.text:
Permittee shall bear any
costs associated with the care or treatment of such injured TRBL.
requirements.deliverable: Payment of injured TRBL rehabilitation/veterinary costs

asNeeded.trigger: an injured TRBL requires care or treatment

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Notify CDFW of TRBL Nest/Colony Abandonment or Distress
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall
immediately notify CDFW (within 24 hours) if TRBL abandon their nests or nestlings are abandoned,
or nesting or roosting colonies exhibit distress and/or abnormal nesting behavior. The Designated
Biologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated Representative shall provide initial notification to the CDFW
Representative. The initial notification to CDFW shall include information regarding the location,
species, date, and circumstances of the event (e.g., time where the…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated Representative
requirements.deliverable: Initial notification to CDFW of TRBL nest/colony abandonment or distress

asNeeded.trigger: TRBL abandon nests, nestlings are abandoned, or a colony exhibits distress or abnormal nesting behavior

timing.stated: within 24 hours

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of TRBL Take or Injury
requirements.name: Submit Written TRBL Incident Report to CDFW
requirements.text:
Following initial notification,
Permittee shall submit to CDFW a written incident report within two business days to the CDFW
offices listed in the Notices section of this ITP. The report shall include the date and time of the
finding or incident, disposition of the TRBL, location of the animal or carcass or name of facility where
the animal was taken, any photographs of the animal or the site it was found, explanation as to cause
of take, injury, or nesting disturbance, and any other pertinent…
requirements.deliverable: Written TRBL incident report to CDFW

asNeeded.trigger: following initial notification of a TRBL take, injury, or colony distress/abandonment incident

timing.stated: within two business days

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response
requirements.name: Avoid CBB Habitat and Confine Ground Disturbance Footprint
requirements.text:
Identified and delineated suitable CBB habitat in accordance with Condition of Approval 10.4 shall be
completely avoided. Permittee shall conduct Covered Activities within paved roads, farm roads, road
shoulders, and similarly previously disturbed and compacted areas to the greatest extent practicable.
Where it is not possible to conduct Covered Activities in already disturbed areas, Permittee shall
confine ground disturbance and habitat removal to the most minimal area necessary as…

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response
requirements.name: Halt Activities Within 50 ft of a Discovered CBB Nest
requirements.text:
If
Project personnel observe CBB or an insect resembling CBB entering or exiting a potential nest, or a
CBB nest site, Permittee shall prohibit Covered Activities within a 50-foot radius of that nest until the
Designated Biologist(s) is contacted and on-site (see Condition of Approval 11.98).

asNeeded.trigger: Project personnel observe CBB or an insect resembling CBB entering/exiting a potential nest, or a CBB nest site

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response
requirements.name: Relocate Unavoidable CBB Nest via Designated Biologist
requirements.text:
If the Covered
Activities cannot avoid the nest, only the Designated Biologist(s) shall relocate the nest in accordance
with Condition of Approval 11.102.
requirements.deliverable: Relocated CBB nest

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities cannot avoid a discovered CBB nest

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Habitat Avoidance and Nest Encounter Response
requirements.name: Report CBB Sightings to the Designated Biologist
requirements.text:
All Project personnel shall inform the Designated Biologist(s) if
they encounter CBB or an insect resembling CBB, within the Project construction site or 50 feet
beyond the Project construction site, during all phases of Covered Activities.
requirements.deliverable: Notice to Designated Biologist(s) of a CBB sighting

asNeeded.trigger: Project personnel encounter CBB or an insect resembling CBB within the construction site or 50 feet beyond it

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Avoid Vegetation/Ground Disturbance During Colony Active Period
requirements.text:
If feasible, Covered Activities shall avoid vegetation and ground disturbing impacts to CBB and
suitable habitat during the Colony Active Period (February 1 – October 31) each year until the
expiration of this ITP unless otherwise approved by CDFW after the Designated Biologist(s) has
conducted CBB surveys (see Condition of Approval 11.97) consistent with CDFW-approved protocols
(Condition of Approval 11.38). Any work within the Colony Active Period shall be subject to approval
by CDFW.

timing.stated: during the Colony Active Period (February 1 – October 31) each year until the expiration of this ITP

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Time Flowering Vegetation Removal Outside Colony Active Period
requirements.text:
Native or non-native flowering vegetation removal shall occur prior to bloom and before
the Colony Active Period to prevent colonization during the active season. If Covered Activities
cannot be avoided in temporary impact areas intended for on-site restoration during this time and
vegetation needs to be removed during the bloom period for these species, Permittee shall remove
flowering vegetation during the Colony Active Period in locations where there are no surveyed
foraging CBB or active…

timing.stated: prior to bloom and before the Colony Active Period

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Avoid Vegetation/Ground Disturbance During Flight Seasons
requirements.text:
Permittee shall avoid conducting Covered Activities involving vegetation and ground disturbance in
CBB habitat during the Queen and Gyne Flight Seasons, when Queens emerge in the spring searching
for nest sites, and during the fall flight period when Gynes mate and search for overwintering habitat.
These time periods shift each year due to climatic conditions (drought, temperature, and
precipitation).

timing.stated: during the Queen and Gyne Flight Seasons

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Survey Annually to Set Flight Season Dates
requirements.text:
To determine these time periods each year, the Designated Biologist(s) shall conduct
CDFW-approved CBB surveys (Condition of Approval 11.38).
requirements.deliverable: Annual CDFW-approved CBB survey results establishing Queen/Gyne Flight Season dates

timing.stated: each year

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Avoid Ground Disturbance During Overwintering Period
requirements.text:
During the overwintering period, Permittee shall avoid ground disturbance activities in CBB habitat to
the greatest extent possible or develop a site-specific phased approach to implementation of
activities, for CDFW approval as part of the appropriate Project Construction Phase Authorization
Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).
requirements.deliverable: CDFW-approved site-specific phased approach for overwintering ground disturbance (where avoidance is not feasible)

timing.stated: During the overwintering period

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Seasonal Restriction on Vegetation and Ground Disturbance
requirements.name: Inspect and Supervise Overwintering Refugia Removal
requirements.text:
During this time, removal of fallen logs, brush piles, woody debris, and other potential refugia for overwintering bees shall be done carefully with prior
inspection and then supervision from the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the
Biological Monitor(s).
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Inspected and supervised removal of overwintering refugia

asNeeded.trigger: refugia (fallen logs, brush piles, woody debris) must be removed during the overwintering period

requirements.name: Conduct Preconstruction CBB Habitat Assessment Survey
requirements.text:
Prior to initiation of ground disturbing Covered Activities for each Project Phase, site-level surveys
shall be conducted consistent with CDFW-approved survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to
determine whether CBB is present within or adjacent to proposed Covered Activities and submitted
to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phased Authorization Package (Condition of
Approval 6.2).
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction CBB habitat assessment submitted to CDFW

deadline.milestone: Initiation of Ground Disturbing Covered Activities

timing.stated: Prior to initiation of ground disturbing Covered Activities for each Project Phase

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance
requirements.name: Conduct Pre-Activity CBB Surveys During Construction/Maintenance
requirements.text:
During the Project construction and postconstruction maintenance phases, surveys shall be
conducted by the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)
following the CDFW-approved CBB survey protocol (Condition of Approval 11.38) prior to any
ground-disturbing Covered Activities or vegetation removal within suitable CBB habitat during the
colony active period (February 1 – October 31) or until all flowering vegetation is largely desiccated,
to detect…
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: CBB pre-activity survey results (foraging detections and active nests) for the construction/maintenance site

timing.stated: at least three surveys, spaced two to four weeks apart, with the last survey within 72 hours prior to construction activity, each year Covered Activities occur in or within 50 feet of suitable CBB habitat

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance
requirements.name: Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection Within 24 Hours
requirements.text:
If a suspected or confirmed CBB is identified during any of
these surveys, the Designated Biologist(s) shall notify CDFW within 24 hours.
requirements.deliverable: Notice to CDFW of a CBB detection

asNeeded.trigger: a suspected or confirmed CBB is identified during a survey

timing.stated: within 24 hours

requirements.commitmentTitle: CBB Surveys During Construction and Maintenance
requirements.name: Report Survey Results in Compliance and Status Reports
requirements.text:
The three survey efforts
conducted during the Project construction phase(s) shall occur each year Covered Activities are
expected to occur in suitable CBB habitat and shall be reported to CDFW by the Permittee within the
Monthly Compliance Reporting (Condition of Approval 10.12) and summarized within each Annual
Status Report (Condition of Approval 10.13).
requirements.deliverable: Survey results included in the Monthly Compliance Report and Annual Status Report

timing.stated: reported within the Monthly Compliance Reporting and summarized within each Annual Status Report

requirements.name: Enforce No-Activity Buffer Around Discovered CBB Nest
requirements.text:
Permittee shall not conduct any Covered Activity within the buffer unless a smaller
buffer is approved by CDFW.

asNeeded.trigger: a 50-ft non-disturbance buffer is established around a discovered CBB nest

requirements.name: Submit CBB Buffer Zone Design Plan to CDFW
requirements.text:
A CBB buffer zone design plan shall be submitted to CDFW as part of the
appropriate Phase Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2).
requirements.deliverable: CBB buffer zone design plan

requirements.name: Delineate and Maintain CBB Nest Buffer Marking
requirements.text:
Utilizing this plan, the buffer
shall be delineated using high-visibility fencing, flagging, or similar materials along with appropriate
signage and be maintained throughout all weather events.
requirements.deliverable: Fenced/flagged/signed CBB nest buffer boundary

requirements.name: Report GPS-Recorded Nest Location to CDFW Within 24 Hours
requirements.text:
The nest location shall be recorded with
global positioning system (GPS) and be reported to CDFW within 24 hours (one calendar day) of
finding the nest.
requirements.deliverable: GPS-recorded nest location report to CDFW

asNeeded.trigger: a CBB nest is discovered

timing.stated: within 24 hours (one calendar day) of finding the nest

requirements.name: Survey Undisturbed CBB Habitat Before Activities Begin
requirements.text:
In undisturbed areas of CBB habitat planned for Covered Activities, the Designated Biologist(s) shall
perform CDFW-approved CBB survey protocols with assistance from the Biological Monitor(s) (if
needed) as described in Condition of Approval 11.38.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) with assistance from the Biological Monitor(s) (if needed)
requirements.deliverable: CBB survey results for the undisturbed habitat area

requirements.name: Conduct Daily Visual Sweeps for CBB Flight Activity
requirements.text:
Once Covered Activities within CBB habitat
have begun, the Designated Biologist(s) and/or Biological Monitor(s) shall be onsite and shall conduct
daily visual sweeps of the Project construction site for CBB flight activity at the start of the daily work
window and shall intermittently repeat these visual sweeps throughout the daily work window.
requirements.deliverable: Daily CBB flight-activity sweep log

timing.stated: at the start of the daily work window, repeated intermittently throughout it

requirements.name: Notify CDFW of a CBB Detection Within 24 Hours
requirements.text:
If a
suspected or confirmed CBB is detected in the Project construction site, the Designated
Representative or Designated Biologist(s) shall contact CDFW by telephone and email within 24 hours.
requirements.deliverable: Notice to CDFW of CBB detection

asNeeded.trigger: a suspected or confirmed CBB is detected in the construction site

timing.stated: within 24 hours

requirements.name: Search for Active Nest After a CBB Detection
requirements.text:
If a suspected or confirmed CBB individual is detected within the Project construction site,
every effort shall be made by the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the
Biological Monitor(s) to find the active nest.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Nest search outcome (located nest, or confirmation none found)

asNeeded.trigger: a suspected or confirmed CBB individual is detected within the construction site

requirements.commitmentTitle: Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia
requirements.name: Avoid and Buffer Underground CBB Refugia
requirements.text:
Permittee shall establish a 50-foot radius no-activity buffer around refugia that can be avoided
within the Project preconstruction activity area, construction site, access roads, SCADA and
transmission line construction areas, and maintenance areas.

asNeeded.trigger: rodent burrows or dry-cavity refugia that can be avoided are present in the work area

requirements.commitmentTitle: Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia
requirements.name: Hold Refugia Vegetation Removal Until Overwintering Absence Confirmed
requirements.text:
Within potential habitat, Permittee
shall avoid removal of vegetation such as woody plants, tall grasses, leaf litter or loose soils until
CDFW-approved CBB survey protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) have been performed by the
Designated Biologist(s) and absence of overwintering CBB is confirmed.

asNeeded.trigger: woody plants, tall grasses, leaf litter, or loose soils in potential CBB habitat require removal

requirements.commitmentTitle: Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia
requirements.name: Flag Refugia and Habitat Features Before Earthmoving
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s)
shall flag these areas, or other habitat features that are outside of the area for direct ground
disturbance within the Project construction site prior to initiation of earthmoving activities in those
areas.
requirements.deliverable: Flagged refugia/habitat features outside the direct-disturbance area

requirements.commitmentTitle: Avoidance or Treatment of CBB Underground Refugia
requirements.name: Repeat CBB Survey After a 14-Day Work Stoppage
requirements.text:
If Covered Activities stop for
more than 14 calendar days, the Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the
Biological Monitor(s) shall repeat CBB surveys within suitable CBB habitat, prior to resuming Covered
Activities.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s)
requirements.deliverable: Repeated CBB survey results before resuming Covered Activities

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities stop for more than 14 calendar days

requirements.name: Minimize Vegetation Disturbance in CBB Habitat
requirements.text:
Disturbance or removal of vegetation shall be kept to the minimum necessary to complete Covered
Activities in suitable CBB habitat.

requirements.name: Hand-Trim Protected Vegetation Only
requirements.text:
Vegetation marked for protection shall only be trimmed with hand
tools limited to string trimmers (e.g., weed whackers) to gain access to work sites unless otherwise
approved by CDFW.

asNeeded.trigger: protected vegetation must be trimmed to gain access to work sites

requirements.name: Set Mower Blade Height to Four Inches Minimum
requirements.text:
Permittee shall set mower blade heights to no lower than four inches, unless
otherwise approved by CDFW in writing (See Condition of Approval 11.18).

asNeeded.trigger: mowing is performed in suitable CBB habitat

requirements.name: Halt Work Within 50-Foot CBB Nest Buffer
requirements.text:
Permittee shall stop Covered Activities within 50 feet of
the nest until the nest senesces or becomes inactive and is no longer in use, as determined by the
Designated Biologist(s) in consultation with CDFW.

asNeeded.trigger: CBB or an insect resembling CBB is observed entering or exiting a potential nest, or a nest site is found

requirements.name: Develop and Submit CBB Nest Relocation Plan
requirements.text:
Permittee shall develop a CBB Nest
Relocation Plan (CBB Plan) and submit it to CDFW as part of the appropriate Construction Phase
Authorization Package (Condition of Approval 6.2) prior to initiating Covered Activities.
requirements.deliverable: CBB Nest Relocation Plan

timing.stated: prior to initiating Covered Activities

requirements.name: Relocate Unavoidable CBB Nest as Last Resort
requirements.text:
The CDFW-
approved Designated Biologist(s) with appropriate expertise in bumble bee capture and handling
shall attempt to relocate the nest to a suitable location outside of the Project construction site
following guidance from CDFW.
requirements.responsibleParty: CDFW-approved Designated Biologist with expertise in bumble bee capture and handling
requirements.deliverable: Relocated CBB nest at a suitable off-site location

asNeeded.trigger: Covered Activities cannot stop and a buffer zone cannot be created around the nest

requirements.name: Monitor Relocated CBB Nest for One Week
requirements.text:
Once relocated, the nest shall be monitored
for at least one week by the Designated Biologist(s).
requirements.deliverable: One-week post-relocation monitoring record confirming continued nest use

asNeeded.trigger: a CBB nest is relocated

timing.stated: monitored for at least one week

requirements.name: Notify CDFW Within 24 Hours of Potential Nest Loss
requirements.text:
CDFW shall be contacted
immediately (within 24 hours) to determine next steps.
requirements.deliverable: CDFW notification of potential nest loss

asNeeded.trigger: a CBB nest may be lost to ground disturbance or cannot be avoided and will be lost

timing.stated: immediately (within 24 hours)

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of CBB Take or Injury
requirements.name: Immediately Notify Biologist of CBB Take or Mortality
requirements.deliverable: Notice to Designated Biologist of CBB take, injury or death

asNeeded.trigger: CBB is taken by a Covered Activity, or found dead or injured near the Project

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of CBB Take or Injury
requirements.name: Provide Initial CDFW Notice of CBB Take Within 1 Day
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) or Permittee’s Designated
Representative shall provide initial notification to the CDFW Representative within one business day
of finding the injured or killed CBB.
requirements.responsibleParty: Designated Biologist or Permittee’s Designated Representative
requirements.deliverable: Initial CDFW notification of CBB take or mortality

deadline.milestone: finding the injured or killed CBB

timing.stated: within one business day of finding the injured or killed CBB

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of CBB Take or Injury
requirements.name: Submit Written CBB Incident Report Within 2 Days
requirements.text: Permittee shall send CDFW a written incident report within two business days to the CDFW offices listed in the Notices section of this ITP.
requirements.deliverable: Written CBB incident report to CDFW

timing.stated: within two business days

requirements.commitmentTitle: Notification of CBB Take or Injury
requirements.name: Salvage and Label CBB Carcass for CDFW Lab
requirements.text:
The carcass shall be photographed, salvaged, and placed in a labeled,
clean plastic, resealable bag or vial and stored in a freezer by the Designated Biologist(s) for shipment
to CDFW Wildlife Health Lab.
requirements.deliverable: Labeled CBB carcass stored for shipment to CDFW Wildlife Health Lab

asNeeded.trigger: a CBB is found dead

requirements.commitmentTitle: MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring
requirements.name: Confine MALI Ground Disturbance to Minimal Footprint
requirements.text:
Permittee shall confine ground disturbance activities that could result in take of MALI to the minimal
area necessary to conduct Covered Activities.

requirements.commitmentTitle: MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring
requirements.name: Station Biologist Onsite Daily During Initial Ground Disturbance
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) shall be onsite each day
during initial ground disturbing activities to assess the Project construction site and no-activity buffer
(Condition of Approval 11.106).
requirements.deliverable: Daily onsite assessment of construction site and no-activity buffer

timing.stated: onsite each day during initial ground disturbing activities

requirements.commitmentTitle: MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring
requirements.name: Monitor Covered Activities in Suitable MALI Habitat
requirements.text:
Following initial ground-disturbance activities, a Designated
Biologist(s) and /or Biological Monitor(s) shall be on site to monitor Covered Activities occurring in
suitable MALI habitat.
requirements.deliverable: Onsite monitoring coverage of Covered Activities in suitable MALI habitat

requirements.commitmentTitle: MALI Initial Site Clearing and Monitoring
requirements.name: Stop Work Pending MALI Translocation Upon Discovery
requirements.text:
If MALI is discovered within the Project construction site, the Designated
Biologist(s) and or Biological Monitor(s) shall have the authority to stop Covered Activities until the
plant is translocated to suitable habitat outside of the Project footprint in accordance with Condition
of Approval 11.108.
requirements.deliverable: Halted activity at the discovery site until MALI is translocated

asNeeded.trigger: MALI is discovered within the Project construction site

requirements.name: Conduct Preconstruction MALI Floristic Survey
requirements.text:
The Designated Biologist(s) with assistance (if needed) from the Biological Monitor(s) shall conduct
preconstruction surveys consistent with CDFW-approved protocols (Condition of Approval 11.38) to
identify the presence of MALI and suitable MALI habitat within all Project sites and a 100-foot buffer
around each Project site, unless otherwise approved by CDFW.
requirements.deliverable: Preconstruction MALI and suitable-habitat survey results

requirements.name: Submit MALI Survey Results for CDFW Approval
requirements.text:
